data.title: 天雨亚子 · 居室床榻的温顺信赖
data.description: 私密居所松软的床褥间，亚子身着轻薄的黑色蕾丝吊带。微卷的长发散落在枕间，她半跪在床榻上，眼眸泛着迷离水光，乖巧地倾身将头靠在老师掌心，展现出无与伦比的极尽柔顺与欢愉依赖。
data.action: kneeling on bed, head resting in hand, black lace camisole, devoted docile gaze
data.lighting: warm golden bedside lamp casting deep seductive silhouettes
data.promptProse: Kneeling on a luxurious soft bed in sheer black lace camisole, Amau Ako tilts her head affectionately into the viewer's palm, looking up with profound, flushed devotion.
data.animaCaption: Ako resting sweetly on the bed in a black camisole.
